messages:
Noah: Dropping a compact eval-row prototype — inline pass/fail toggle, small regression diff peek, and a "replay prompt" button that opens the prompt editor. Screenshot in thread.
Cam: Love compact rows for scan-speed. Concern: toggle affordance might look like a checkbox; maybe use segmented chips 'Pass | Fail' to avoid confusion.
Priya: Accessibility note: chips need aria-pressed and a clear focus ring. Also ensure 'Pass'/'Fail' state is read by screen readers as 'Test result: Pass' not just 'Pushbutton'.
Taylor: Copy thought: instead of 'Replay prompt' maybe 'Re-run with prompt' or 'Replay with context' ? Keeps intent clearer.
Noah: I like 'Re-run with prompt' — it's explicit. For the diff peek, I want a 3-line compact summary with +/- highlights. Full diff opens full panel.
Cam: Small screens: diff peek should collapse to a single-line summary with an expand chevron. Avoid stacking buttons.
Priya: Color note: don't rely on green/red alone for pass/fail. Add icons (check/x) + text. Also provide an alternative text-only compact mode in prefs.
Noah: Good call. We'll add both. Also thinking about keyboard shortcuts: 'r' to replay, 'd' to open diff, arrow keys to navigate rows. Thoughts on conflicts?
Taylor: Might conflict with browser shortcuts in some contexts. Should be enabled only when the eval table has focus. Add an onscreen hint in the header: 'Press / for shortcuts' style.
Cam: Layout nit: the scorecard currently uses a light grey row separator; in compact mode the separator feels dense. Maybe remove separators and use increased row padding + hover highlight.
Priya: Contrast check: hover highlight must meet 3:1 on top of dark theme too. Add tokenized text contrast rules for diff highlights.
accessibility-bot: a11y scan: compact-row prototype fails keyboard focus order test on staging. See report: https://a11y.redwood.ai/reports/2212345678
Noah: Thanks. We'll fix tab order. Also request: include aria-label on the diff peek button 'Show regression diff for test X'.
Cam: Microcopy in the tooltip for replay: 'Re-run this test using the original prompt and settings'. Keep short.
Taylor: For enterprise customers with PII prompts, replay should warn if prompt contains sensitive data and require confirmation. Add a modal copy: 'This prompt may contain sensitive data. Confirm re-run?'.
Priya: Modal must include explicit consent checkbox and audit log note for compliance.
storybook-bot: Storybook preview published: https://staging.redwood.ai/storybook/compact-evals-rows (branch/feat/compact-evals)
Noah: Next steps: Cam updates compact spacing + chips, Priya adjusts a11y focus and contrast, Taylor drafts modal copy, I'll iterate tooltip text and add keyboard binding guard. I'll post updated mock by tomorrow AM.
Cam: Will post responsive variants (desktop/phone) and a dense-toggle state.
Priya: I'll re-run a11y scan after the changes and attach checklist items.
Taylor: I'll own the enterprise modal copy and permission gating.
Noah: Thanks all — this will make eval scanning ~10x faster :rocket:
